name: Book End of Dragon Gate
description: In ancient China, there were four major mythical beasts: Suzaku, Xuanwu, Qinglong, and White Tiger. They guarded the four directions of north, south, east and west respectively. The green dragon is the god of the East, with a majestic appearance. People believe that it has the function of attracting good luck and avoiding evil. It is often depicted in palaces, palace gates, city gates and other places. In Feng Shui, opening the door on the left side of the building is called the Qinglong Gate, which is conducive to gathering earth energy, promoting luck and wealth, and bringing blessings and happiness. Making Qinglong Gate into a book rest is not only practical and beautiful, but also has a beautiful meaning of academic progress, achievement, and promotion.
